mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next five trading days through improved consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances during high inflation, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth, measured by a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000, signals robust economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 100,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1,000,000 units signal strong residential demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as construction and related sectors expand.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (GDPC1 QoQ growth < 0%), a rebound in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ growth > 0%) signals economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances during recessionary regimes, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.
